Brand Introduction:
Tolevita is a brand that creates innovative patches for health and beauty support. We offer transparent patches with active ingredients that provide a convenient and effective way to care for your body and skin.

Product Description:
Tolevita Iron Patches with Vitamin C are unique transparent patches designed to maintain optimal iron levels and enhance its absorption with the help of Vitamin C. These patches are created for people with an active lifestyle, offering a simple and convenient way to replenish iron deficiency and maintain energy throughout the day.

Product Benefits:

  • Enhanced iron absorption thanks to the addition of Vitamin C.

  • Convenient use: Simply apply the patch to clean skin.

  • Long-lasting effect: Works for up to 8 hours.

  • Invisible and comfortable to wear under clothing.

  • Perfect for an active lifestyle, traveling, and everyday use.

USP (Unique Selling Points):

  1. Fast and Effective Iron Absorption: Vitamin C helps optimize the iron absorption process.

  2. Convenient Format: No capsules or pills – just apply the patch and enjoy the benefits.

  3. Long-lasting Impact: Provides a steady supply of nutrients throughout the day.

  4. Invisibility and Comfort: Transparent patches that are easy to wear under clothing without discomfort.

  5. Perfect Companion for Active People: Use it while traveling, during workouts, or on busy days.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission for Bloggers: 10% per sale made through their link.

  • Discount for Blogger’s Followers: 10% discount when purchasing via referral link.

Other Information:

  • We will provide bloggers with all necessary promotional materials upon request (photos, videos, texts).

  • Opportunity to receive free samples for creating original content.

  • Personalized approach for each blogger and long-term collaboration.
